package appsinterface

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/z-chenhao/assistant/pkg/rsiplugin"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

type viewSource struct {
	Program []string `json:"program"`
}

func readOwnViewSource(name string) ([]byte, viewSource, error) {
	var source viewSource
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, source, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(executable), name))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, source, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, source, err
	}
	if len(raw) > 4096 {
		return nil, source, fmt.Errorf("view resource exceeds limit")
	}
	if err = rsiplugin.Decode(raw, &source); err != nil {
		return nil, source, err
	}
	return raw, source, nil
}
